question: Does frozen G1 require a separate complete cross-end differential comparator program for UI3/UI4 and all Windows arrangements?

frozenSources.readLevel: Exact frozen bytes hash and necessary matrix/HTTP/UI/ownership/closure paragraphs read; current Gate-only metadata not used to rewrite input.
Exact frozen raw hash; UI complete structured block, required shared checks and risks/closeout read. No requirement for a separate UI differential tool found.
Frozen matrix, actual UI/bridge split, current-candidate rerun and reuse text.
Exact frozen raw hash and formal compatibility/real integration/browser/shared-scene requirements.
Frozen raw hash and real PG/semantics/stage evidence constraints.

basis.text: Four journeys × four arrangements; actual network status/full response and business results; migrated115 fixed to candidate and declared remaining Native routes, never response-based fallback.
basis.interpretation: Specifies real observations and contract coverage. It does not prescribe a dedicated pairwise comparator implementation, unique report format or equal rendered bytes.

basis.text: UI3 requires real approval Todo/detail/reject/resubmit/approve, candidate L4 and Todo/profile; UI4 actual controls/request bytes/download hash and selected cancellation/negative target, writers closed.
basis.interpretation: These original semantic assertions can be executed on each declared backend/platform using the same pinned journey code. Separate specialized all-field UI diff software is not stated.

basis.text: Fields/null/date/versions/status/errors/security/side effects remain compatible; real PG/E2E, independent same-source copies and shared HTTP scenes.
basis.interpretation: Tool choice is flexible, semantic evidence is not. An observed discrepancy still needs a real disposition and cannot be dismissed because both journey summaries say observed.

minimumExistingEvidenceRoute.requiredEvidence: Current candidate actual run receipts for each selected journey on Linux managed Nest/Rust, Windows managed Nest and Windows browser external Linux Rust. Same pinned journey/assertion source and explicit frontend/API/build/cap identity. Windows actual Node/browser/platform/env/owned process and external owner linkage remain real evidence.
minimumExistingEvidenceRoute.notRequired: Pixel/DOM identity, Rust-native-Windows binary or a new comparator merely because platform changes.

minimumExistingEvidenceRoute.requiredEvidence: Original UI controls/Angular interceptor/cookies and fixed bridge actions separately labelled; each actual method/path/backend/status/full raw response/schema and original business assertions retained. UI3 actual owned approval/Todo/profile transitions; UI4 actual upload/final/package bytes/hash and original selected cancellation/negative behavior. No fake200, hidden error or Native fallback.

Existing actual typed SDK/PG/outer-COMMIT/independent-visibility proof chain, all107 snapshots/outside-scope checks, exact owned effects, source/binary binding, owner quiescence, observer/fault/lease restoration and twice-zero cleanup. Root may consume already collected per-HTTP complete frames; this decision does not add a new extra snapshot schedule.

Link UI operations/output assertions to the same-candidate complete M3/M4 API compatibility evidence where applicable. A small index or clear existing receipt links can show step/path/checked fields/side effects and source/scope correspondence. UI-only inputs/outputs or cancellation branches not covered there need their original independent UI semantic assertions or the narrowly missing evidence.
minimumExistingEvidenceRoute.notRequired: Repeat every API physical/all-field comparison inside a new UI-only program when the original same-source UI assertions plus complete matched API proof already cover it.

minimumExistingEvidenceRoute.requiredEvidence: Keep all original failed/partial/uncertified results. Any newly observed state/body/business difference remains visible and must be fixed or classified through the accepted process. Existing UI12 strict cached304/200 differences are not erased; controlled-uncached corrective conditions must be measured where used. Binary K no-store/HEAD/Range/payload boundaries remain unchanged.

coverageExamples.UI3: Actual same-source browser entry/detail/reject/resubmit/approve and live Todo/profile behavior plus targeted L4 response/row-version/action evidence. M3 complete API data/transaction comparison closes overlapping contract semantics; remaining UI-only behavior is asserted directly.
coverageExamples.UI4: Actual file/control/request/upload bytes/final/package download and cancellation or chosen negative-target behavior. M4 complete API attachment/K/OBS comparison and mature archive payload/manifest proof may be linked for overlapping semantics; a screenshot or HTTP200 alone is insufficient.
coverageExamples.Windows: Repeat actual four-journey arrangement against pinned source and real Windows runtime. Reuse unaffected API semantic proof by explicit source/impact link; do not relabel Linux browser execution as Windows.
